name: AI Inline Code Completion
author: Tahr Team
description: AI-powered inline code suggestions (ghost text) with built-in llama-server integration and support for custom local or cloud OpenAI-compatible providers

endpoint.description: API completion URL for local llama-server or remote LLM

port.description: Port used by local llama-server daemon

model.description: Model identifier used for code completion requests

model_path.description: Path to local GGUF model weights

api_key.description: API key for authenticated cloud providers (OpenAI, DeepSeek, etc.)

debounce_ms.description: Typing pause delay in milliseconds before requesting completion

max_tokens.description: Maximum generated token count per suggestion
